html:
King of Songhai from about 1464 to 1492 and the founder of the Songhai Empire. From his base at Gao on the Niger he took over the lands of the fading Mali Empire. His birth date is unknown.

  • He took Timbuktu from the Tuareg in 1468.
  • He took Djenné after a long siege.
  • He used a river fleet and fast cavalry to campaign along the Niger every year.

Muslim chroniclers of Timbuktu, writing later under his rivals, remembered him as a cruel ruler who persecuted scholars and mixed Islam with older beliefs. In Songhai oral tradition he is a great king with magic powers. He died in 1492, reportedly drowned while crossing a river. Within a year his general Askia Muhammad had overthrown his son and taken the throne.
